title: VeloraOS 1.10.58 - Universal Command Palette
releaseNotes: Adds a global Universal Command Palette available with Ctrl+K, Command+K and dedicated desktop and mobile launch controls.
Searches apps, settings, saved chats, Knowledge files and protected appliance actions with ranked typo-tolerant matching.
Adds the extensible window.VeloraCommands registry so current and future workspaces can register their own actions.
Adds per-account pinned and recent commands, keyboard navigation, safety confirmations and dark, light and system appearance commands.
